_metadata.description: Truthful version identity, durable evidence, safe retirement, and the dogfooded Progression surface.

requirements.title: Version identity survives reindex
requirements.description: Every indexed version has first-seen and release timestamps, and semver lists remain newest-first after repeated indexing.

validation.notes: API repository tests plus live SQLite backfill and byte-identical double-index dump.

requirements.title: Evidence is retained per version
requirements.description: Gate evidence and component test verdicts remain readable by version after later runs, with bounded payload retention and lossless rollup counters.

validation.notes: Version-keyed gate schema, newest-three retention, and live rollup totals verified.

requirements.title: Ledger outlives source folders
requirements.description: One replayable ledger row per library/version retains lifecycle, quality, adoption, and size facts, including retired versions.

validation.notes: Ledger rebuild runs at startup and after indexing; stable library_id keys are exercised against the live corpus.

requirements.title: Retirement is reference-safe
requirements.description: Operators can list candidates and transition versions through deprecate, archive, and explicitly confirmed retire operations while refusing latest, draft, or referenced versions.

validation.notes: Lifecycle Connect service and CLI manifest expose the guarded verbs; retirement requires confirmation and three reference checks.

requirements.title: Progression is dogfooded
requirements.description: Asset detail exposes a sibling Progression tab using the adopted CartesianCharts asset and keeps retired versions on the axis.

validation.notes: UI type-check, catalog conformance, and 446 Vitest tests pass; adopted component path is under ui/src/components/ui.
